proposition: In the R. Suʾl al-Mulūk Ibn Turka treats the quranic letters as giving both bodily healing and ascent toward nearness to God, presenting the practical and theoretical modes as interdependent.

mediation.who: Melvin-Koushki, paraphrasing or translating Ibn Turka's own work
mediation.note: a work written for Bāysunghur, a patron interested in applied lettrism
